title: Union Cabinet clears Rs 1.9 lakh crore push for chips, mobile phones
summary: The Union Cabinet approved two schemes totaling Rs 1.9 lakh crore for electronics manufacturing. These initiatives aim to boost semiconductor fabrication and mobile phone production significantly.
